integrity: The cyclic-gap proof is self-contained. A separately runnable Python checker compares exhaustive graph tests and gap counts in fourteen cyclic orders and tests the stated infinite-family constructions over further orders. Historical novelty is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: The statement classifies the fixed normalized three-point support {0,1,4} across all cyclic orders at least five; it does not classify all triples or all finite groups. Older independent-domination results under alternative terminology could provide prior coverage. Finite checks corroborate but do not establish the infinite theorem.
title: Sharp index-stability cutoff and maximal-subfactor gaps for a cyclic three-point set
